summary.intent: Update the codebase map documents after phases 28-33, clean up stale planning artifacts, and organize pending todos into a new phase.
summary.outcome: CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md were updated to reflect resolved concerns from phases 28-33, stale references (legacy POC, docker host IP, phase annotations) were sanitized across 15+ planning files, DEFERRED.md and the security backlog were audited and updated, and Phase 34 (E2E test expansion) was added to the roadmap covering 6 pending todos.

repo: Phase 28 removed the legacy POC directory (commit ee9bcd4e4) and replaced 127 console.* calls with structured logger at apps/web/src/lib/logger.ts
Phase 30 added Grafana Faro observability (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) but registerFaroTransport() is defined and never called — logger errors don't reach Faro
Phase 31 decomposed useSharedNavigation.ts (1199→378 lines) and FileBrowser.tsx (964→362 lines) into 6 hooks plus folder-helpers.ts
Phase 32 resolved macOS FilePointer async blocking; Phase 33 resolved the same for Windows using rt.spawn() channel patterns in crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/read_ops.rs
19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites remain in FUSE production code — a new concern post-phase 33
web3auth/hooks.ts still has 12 console.time/timeEnd calls not covered by the Phase 28 logger migration
IPNS unenrollment is fire-and-forget with no persistence across tab closure — known architectural gap
folder.service.ts (1059 lines) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) remain large but are below the prior threshold for a dedicated concern entry
7 of 19 low-severity security backlog items (all Phase 9 items #13-19) were resolved organically across later phases but never marked as such in LOW-SEVERITY-BACKLOG.md
The Entire CLI injects git hooks (.husky/post-commit, .husky/pre-push, .husky/prepare-commit-msg, .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire) as local untracked files — not project files

workflow: When rebasing/pulling with divergent branches after a docs commit, stash the specific files, reset to origin, then restore — avoids complex merge conflicts on planning docs
The gsd-codebase-mapper agent pattern works well for targeted updates: spawn only the agents whose focus areas were affected by recent phases rather than full refresh
IP addresses and environment-specific values in planning docs should be sanitized with semantic placeholders (e.g. <docker-host>) to preserve meaning without leaking infrastructure details
Security backlogs and deferred items tend to go stale silently — periodic audits against phase summaries are needed to keep them accurate
The Entire CLI's local git hooks should be added to .git/info/exclude rather than .gitignore to avoid polluting the project's ignore rules

friction: git pull failed on divergent branches after the initial CONCERNS.md + STRUCTURE.md commit because Phase 33 had just been merged to origin/main — required stash, reset, and re-run of the concerns mapper
The concerns mapper had to be run twice (once before Phase 33 merge, once after) because the branch state wasn't confirmed before starting
Multiple sequential edits were required to update STRUCTURE.md status column and LOW-SEVERITY-BACKLOG.md due to the granularity of changes needed — no bulk replace was possible
